from unittest.mock import patch
from pathlib import Path
view = Path.cwd().resolve()

import learner_retention as r

assert Path(refresh_retention.__file__).resolve().parent == view / "ops"

tree = ast.parse(source)
methods = {'refresh_dir', 'test_refresh_history_and_failed_cap_and_plan', 'test_refresh_active_and_symlinked_intermediates_are_preserved'}
original = next((node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'Backlog'))

ast.fix_missing_locations(selected)
namespace = dict(unittest=unittest, dt=dt, r=r, refresh_retention=refresh_retention, patch=patch)
exec(compile(selected, str(candidate / 'ops/tests/test_retention_backlog.py'), 'exec'), namespace)
def setup(self):
    self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='issue76-fixed-input-')

    self.directory.mkdir(parents=True)
case = namespace['OriginalAssertions']
case.setUp = setup
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(case)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
